bif.translation: abbr. bifocal 双焦点的; buyer-induced failure 买方导致的失误

biface.definition: s having two faces or fronts
biface.translation: n. (旧石器时代的)两面器(即两面加工的一种石块, 为手斧的雏型)

bifacial.definition: s having two faces or fronts
bifacial.translation:
a. 有两面的
[医] 两面的[畸胎]

bifarious.definition:
a. Twofold; arranged in two rows.
a. Pointing two ways, as leaves that grow only on opposite
   sides of a branch; in two vertical rows.
bifarious.translation: [植]二重的, 二列的, 相背的

bife.translation: abbr. built in focus error 内部聚焦误差

bifer.translation: n. 一年开花或结实两次的植物

biferous.definition: a. Bearing fruit twice a year.
biferous.translation: a. 一年开花或结实两次的

bifes.translation: (bife 的复数) abbr. built in focus error 内部聚焦误差

biff.definition:
n (boxing) a blow with the fist
v strike, usually with the fist

biffed.definition: v strike, usually with the fist
biffed.translation: v. 打( biff的过去式和过去分词 )

biffin.definition:
n. A sort of apple peculiar to Norfolk, Eng.
n. A baked apple pressed down into a flat, round cake; a dried
   apple.

biffing.definition: v strike, usually with the fist
biffing.translation: v. 打( biff的现在分词 )

biffins.definition:
plural of biffin
n. A sort of apple peculiar to Norfolk, Eng.
n. A baked apple pressed down into a flat, round cake; a dried
   apple.
biffins.translation: (biffin 的复数) n. 红苹果

biffs.definition:
n (boxing) a blow with the fist
v strike, usually with the fist
biffs.translation: v. 打( biff的第三人称单数 )

biffy.translation: 户外洗手间, 户外厕所, 室内洗手间

bifid.translation:
a. 二分的, 二裂的
[医] 两叉的, 对裂的

bifidus.translation: ①二裂的②两叉的③二分的④双裂的

bifidus factor.translation: [化] 两岐乳杆菌生长因子

bifilar.definition: a. having or using two filaments

bifistular.translation: [医] 有两管的, 两管的

biflex.translation: a. 有两处弯曲的, 朝两个方向弯曲的

bifocal.translation:
a. 双焦的
[医] 双焦点的

bifocals.definition: n. eyeglasses having two focal lengths, one for near vision and the other for far vision

bifold.definition: a. Twofold; double; of two kinds, degrees, etc.

bifoliolate.definition: a. Having two leaflets, as some compound leaves.

biform.definition: s. having or combining two forms

biformed.translation: a. 二形的, 二形结合的

biformin.translation: 双形蕈素, 双形真菌素

bifrons.translation: 背靠背的两人半身雕塑像

bifronted.translation: a. 双面的, 双锋的

bifrost.translation: n. (北欧神话中)连接天地的彩虹桥

bifs.translation: (bif 的复数) abbr. bifocal 双焦点的; buyer-induced failure 买方导致的失误

bifunctional.translation: a. 具有两种(截然)不同功能的

bifunctional catalyst.translation: [化] 双官能催化剂; 双功能催化剂

bifunctional monomer.translation: [化] 双官能单体; 双官能基单体

bifurcate.definition:
v. split or divide into two
v. divide into two branches
s. resembling a fork; divided or separated into two branches
bifurcate.translation:
v. (使)分叉
a. 分双叉的

bifurcated.definition: s. divided into or made up of two parts
bifurcated.translation:
a. 分为两部分
v. （指道路、河流、树枝等）分岔, 分成两支( bifurcate的过去式和过去分词 ); 使分枝, 使分叉

bifurcates.definition:
v split or divide into two
v divide into two branches
bifurcates.translation:
n. （指道路、河流、树枝等）分岔, 分成两支( bifurcate的名词复数 ); 使分枝, 使分叉; 分叉的
v. （指道路、河流、树枝等）分岔, 分成两支( bifurcate的第三人称单数 ); 使分枝, 使分叉

bifurcating.definition:
v split or divide into two
v divide into two branches
bifurcating.translation: v. （指道路、河流、树枝等）分岔, 分成两支( bifurcate的现在分词 ); 使分枝, 使分叉

bifurcation.definition:
n. a bifurcating branch (one or both of them)
n. the place where something divides into two branches
n. the act of splitting into two branches
bifurcation.translation:
n. 双叉, 分叉, 分歧, 分歧点
[计] 双态; 分叉

bifurcations.definition:
plural of bifurcation
n. a bifurcating branch (one or both of them)
n. the place where something divides into two branches
n. the act of splitting into two branches
bifurcations.translation:
(bifurcation 的复数) n. 双叉, 分叉, 分歧, 分歧点
[计] 双态; 分叉
